name: CRM - Sales Pipeline Dashboard
description: Metabase dashboard configuration for CRM sales pipeline visualization

native.query: SELECT stage as status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(value) as total_value FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_opportunities GROUP BY stage ORDER BY total_value DESC
SELECT contact_name as full_name, company_name as company, email, source, created_at FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_leads WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT source, COUNT(CASE WHEN stage='CONVERTED' THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as conversion_rate FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_leads GROUP BY source

SELECT date_trunc('month', expected_close_date) as month, SUM(value * probability_pct/100) as forecast FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_opportunities WHERE stage NOT IN ('CLOSED_WON','CLOSED_LOST') AND expected_close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
